scientific_limitations: The formula requires an equal-weight single cap on the coordinate unit cube and the inherited Euclidean metric.
The integer-cap specialization was previously known for uniform matroid independence polytopes; the noninteger fractional vertex transitions are the claimed new contribution.
title: Fractional-cap plateaus and sharp contact transitions of Euclidean cube circumballs
